description: This PHP class 'EmployeeTimesheetAPI' serves as an API endpoint for managing employee timesheets within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, and updating timesheets, as well as handling related validation and permission checks. The class integrates with various services and traits to facilitate CRUD operations, validation, authentication, and workflow management related to employee timesheets.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetAPI
classes.description: API class handling employee timesheets, including listing, creating, and updating timesheets, with validation, authorization, and workflow management features.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list an employee's timesheets with date range filtering, validation, and pagination.

methods.name: validateDateInputs
methods.description: Validates the date inputs for relative consistency and logical order.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number from request attributes.

methods.name: getFromDateParam
methods.description: Fetches the 'fromDate' query parameter as a DateTime object.

methods.name: getToDateParam
methods.description: Fetches the 'toDate' query parameter as a DateTime object.

methods.name: getTimeSheets
methods.description: Fetches timesheets within the specified date range and returns the result with total count.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new timesheet entry for the specified employee and date.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing timesheet's status/action and logs the change, with transaction handling.

methods.name: setTimesheetActionLog
methods.description: Records an action taken on a timesheet, including the user, comment, and timestamp.
